# Sermon Keeper

> AI-powered sermon notes app for iOS. Record the sermon live, take timestamped notes, autocomplete Bible verses (offline KJV), and get an AI transcript with a summary and key points. Built specifically for churchgoers.

## About

Sermon Keeper is an iOS app for church-going Christians who want to capture, remember, and reflect on sermons. It combines audio recording, timestamped note-taking, Bible verse autocomplete, and AI transcription in one simple app — designed to be used during a live service. You can record even with no internet in the sanctuary and transcribe once you're back online.

## Key Features

- One-tap sermon recording in high-quality audio
- Timestamped notes — each note saves the exact moment in the sermon so you can jump back to it
- Bible verse autocomplete — type a reference like John 3:16 and see the full verse (works offline for KJV)
- AI transcription with an organized summary and key points (cloud-based; the audio is deleted after transcription)
- SOAP study cards — scan a Bible page and get a Scripture / Observation / Application / Prayer journal in about 30 seconds
- iCloud sync — your notes sync through your own personal iCloud, not our servers
- Works in English and Spanish
- No account required — download and start recording immediately

## Pricing

- Free 3-day trial (on the yearly plan)
- $6.99/month or $64.99/year for unlimited recordings and transcriptions

## Who It's For

- Busy church-goers who want to remember the sermon but can't take detailed notes during service
- Bible study groups who want to share accurate sermon notes without retyping everything
- New believers who want to catch every Bible reference the pastor mentions

## Technical Details

- Platform: iOS (iPhone; runs on iPad)
- Bible Version: King James Version (KJV), more translations coming
- Recording: works offline in the sanctuary; the audio is uploaded for transcription once you're online, then deleted from our server
- Notes storage: your notes sync through your personal iCloud, not our servers
- Languages: English, Spanish
